proof_0385.moves: Says the scalar action on a.e.-equivalence classes commutes with the quotient map mk; true by definitional unfolding of the AEEqFun SMul instance, so the proof is rfl. No mathematical step beyond the instance being defined by lifting.

proof_0386.moves: The identity map is conformal because it is conformal at every point; fix a point and cite the pointwise statement.

proof_0387.moves: Composing a manifold-differentiable map with the first projection: cite that Prod.fst is mdifferentiable on the product model and use the composition rule.

proof_0388.moves: For a nonzero real exponent, x^z = y^z iff x = y: get injectivity of the base map from the nonzero exponent, then turn injectivity into an iff.

proof_0389.moves: Unprimed version of the conditional-probability product rule: discharge the side condition that the measure of the conditioning set is finite (from IsFiniteMeasure) and apply the primed lemma.

proof_0390.moves: Transfers the MeromorphicOn-on-univ statement about the logarithmic derivative of a zpow to the global Meromorphic predicate, by rewriting meromorphic = meromorphicOn univ and applying the set version.

proof_0391.moves: The left-multiplication dilation equivalence, applied to a point, is just multiplication; true by definitional unfolding of the coercion, proved by rfl.

proof_0392.moves: Symmetric difference respects a.e. equality of sets: specialize the general filter lemma that EventuallyEq is preserved by symmDiff to the a.e. filter.

proof_0393.moves: A cyclotomic extension of a field by a finite set of indices is finite-dimensional: cite the module-finiteness result and repackage it as finite dimensionality.

proof_0394.moves: Eta/lambda-form restatement of the sum rule for differentiability at a point; the proof just applies DifferentiableAt.add. No new mathematics.

proof_0395.moves: Computes the map on fundamental groups induced by an equality of basepoints: identify the fundamental group with an endomorphism monoid in the fundamental groupoid and rewrite the induced map as conjugation by eqToHom (with the equality taken in the right direction).

proof_0396.moves: Lipschitz bound for the WithLp product coercion: the whole proof is a call to the private auxiliary lemma proved earlier in the file, under the Fact (1 <= p) hypothesis.

proof_0397.moves: If the negation of f is Lipschitz on a set then so is f: take the forward direction of the iff characterizing Lipschitz-ness of -f.

proof_0398.moves: The inverse of the continuous-linear-equiv coming from a linear isometry equiv is the one coming from its inverse; both sides unfold to the same data, so rfl.

proof_0399.moves: Two measures agreeing on the restrictions to each member of a countable cover of the universe are equal: take the mpr direction of the corresponding iff lemma.

proof_0400.moves: The measure with density given by the Radon-Nikodym derivative is sigma-finite because it is dominated by the reference measure, and sigma-finiteness passes down along domination.

proof_0401.moves: Variant of the congruence lemma for Frechet derivatives within a set where the agreement hypothesis is an EqOn plus membership of the base point; instantiate EqOn at the point and apply the existing congr lemma.

proof_0402.moves: Destructure the a.e.-measurability hypothesis into a measurable representative g together with f =ae g, note g is null-measurable, and transfer back along the (symmetrized) a.e. equality. The witness extraction is the real first step and no citation names it.

proof_0403.moves: The first-marginal kernel is s-finite: rewrite fst as the pushforward under Prod.fst and conclude by the already-known s-finiteness of a mapped kernel.

proof_0404.moves: The discrete functor into light condensed modules is faithful because it is naturally isomorphic to the locally-constant functor, which is faithful; transport faithfulness along that isomorphism.

proof_0405.moves: Primed restatement of the additivity of the iterated integral against a kernel composition-product; the proof just applies the unprimed lemma with the same integrability hypotheses.

proof_0406.moves: The forgetful functor from affine schemes to schemes acts on morphisms as the identity, since affine schemes are a full/induced subcategory; the equation is definitional, proved by rfl.

proof_0407.moves: Congruence for gradients within a set under the hypothesis that the base point lies in the set: instantiate the pointwise agreement at that point and apply the existing congr lemma.

proof_0408.moves: A bump function is smooth: apply the general result that a bump built from smooth center and radius data is smooth, supplying constants for the radii and the identity for the argument.
